_doc: Assumed economics for dc2_s (data-center hardware, installed base with refresh cycles). Every value is 'assumed' and carries its basis.

retention_sensitivity_per_health_point.basis: assumed: hardware revenue is realized at refresh and repeat orders, not monthly; a 50-point health span is taken to move 12-month refresh/repeat revenue by ~12.5% of the base, i.e. 0.25% per point

revenue_at_risk_share_by_band.basis: assumed: share of the account's annual hardware+support revenue expected to be lost within the horizon (support lapse, refresh lost to a competitor), by health band; multi-year installed base churns slowly but in large steps at refresh
